title: Jonah Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on Jonah 4: Jonah's anger, his prayer under the booth, the vine and the worm, and Yahweh's last question about the great city.

questions.text: What does the first verse of this chapter say about Jonah?
questions.explanation: It displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he was angry.

answers.text: He was displeased and angry
He rejoiced greatly
He was afraid and fled
He gave thanks at once

questions.text: What did Jonah say he knew about God, which was why he had fled to Tarshish?
questions.explanation: He said he knew that God is gracious and merciful, slow to anger and abundant in loving kindness, and that he relents of doing harm.

answers.text: That God never changes his word once spoken
That God had chosen another prophet for this
That God is gracious and relents of doing harm
That God would send him back to his own country

questions.text: What did Jonah ask of Yahweh in that prayer?
questions.explanation: He asked Yahweh to take his life from him, saying it was better for him to die than to live.

answers.text: That Yahweh overthrow the city
That Yahweh take his life from him
That Yahweh send him home again
That Yahweh give him a sign

questions.text: Where did Jonah sit after he went out of the city?
questions.explanation: He went out of the city, sat on the east side of it, made himself a booth and sat under it in the shade.

answers.text: On the wall above the gate
In the house of the king
Beside the sea to the west
On the east side, under a booth

questions.text: What did Yahweh God prepare to shade Jonah's head?
questions.explanation: Yahweh God prepared a vine and made it come up over Jonah, to be a shade over his head and deliver him from his discomfort.

answers.text: A vine
A cloud
A fig tree
A tent

questions.explanation: God prepared a worm at dawn the next day, and it chewed on the vine, so that it withered.

answers.text: A sudden hailstorm
A worm that God prepared
A swarm of locusts
A fire in the night

questions.text: What did God prepare when the sun arose?
questions.explanation: God prepared a sultry east wind, and the sun beat on Jonah's head so that he fainted and asked to die.

answers.text: A heavy rain cloud
A storm on the sea
A second green vine
A sultry east wind

questions.text: How did Jonah answer when God asked whether it was right to be angry about the vine?
questions.explanation: Jonah said he was right to be angry, even to death.

answers.text: He said nothing at all to God's question
He said that the vine did not matter now
He said he was right to be angry, even to death
He said he had been wrong to be angry

questions.text: What did Yahweh say about the vine that Jonah had been concerned for?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said Jonah had not labored for the vine nor made it grow, and that it came up in a night and perished in a night.

answers.text: Jonah neither labored for it nor made it grow
Jonah had planted it with his own hands
Jonah had watered it for many days
Jonah had asked God to make it grow

questions.text: What does Yahweh say is in Nineveh, that great city?
questions.explanation: He says there are more than one hundred twenty thousand persons in it who cannot discern between their right hand and their left, and also much livestock.

answers.text: Seventy elders and the king's whole household
Ten thousand soldiers and their war horses
A thousand priests and all their servants
Over a hundred twenty thousand people and much livestock
